mapper.select: select id as userId, userName, head as userHead from user where id = #{userId}

select pi.post_id, pi.post_type, COALESCE(cl.type, li.type, crn.type) as postSubType, COALESCE(cl.title, li.item_name, crn.title) as title, COALESCE(cl.create_time, li.create_time, crn.create_time) as createTime from post_interaction pi left join confession_log cl on pi.post_id = cl.id and pi.post_type = 1 left join lost_item li on pi.post_id = li.id and pi.post_type = 2 left join club_recruitment_news crn on pi.post_id = crn.id and pi.post_type = 3 where pi.user_id = #{userId} and pi.is_liked = 1

select pi.post_id, pi.post_type, COALESCE(cl.type, li.type, crn.type) as postSubType, COALESCE(cl.title, li.item_name, crn.title) as title, COALESCE(cl.create_time, li.create_time, crn.create_time) as createTime from post_interaction pi left join confession_log cl on pi.post_id = cl.id and pi.post_type = 1 left join lost_item li on pi.post_id = li.id and pi.post_type = 2 left join club_recruitment_news crn on pi.post_id = crn.id and pi.post_type = 3 where pi.user_id = #{userId} and pi.is_favored = 1

select co.post_id, co.post_type, co.content, co.image_url, co.create_time, COALESCE(cl.type, li.type, crn.type) as postSubType, COALESCE(cl.title, li.item_name, crn.title) as title from comment co left join confession_log cl on co.post_id = cl.id and co.post_type = 1 left join lost_item li on co.post_id = li.id and co.post_type = 2 left join club_recruitment_news crn on co.post_id = crn.id and co.post_type = 3 where co.user_id = #{userId}
